en.headline: Hong Kong Electronics Fair Autumn edition enters final day at HKCEC
en.dek: The HKTDC-organised fair and concurrent electronicAsia feature more than 3200 exhibitors focusing on AI, robotics and future industries until 5pm today.
body: The Hong Kong Electronics Fair (Autumn Edition) and the concurrent electronicAsia enter their final day on Friday at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai.

Organised by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council, the physical fairs run from 13 to 16 October and bring together more than 3200 exhibitors from 15 countries and regions. Key focuses include artificial intelligence, robotics, smart wellness and next-generation entertainment, with a new Future Industries Zone highlighting emerging technologies.

Friday's opening hours are 9:30am to 5pm. Admission is for trade visitors aged 18 or above, with an onsite registration fee of HK$100, though e-badge and pre-registered buyers enter free. Online matching continues through the Click2Match platform until 23 October.
The HKTDC said the twin fairs provide a platform for sourcing innovations spanning consumer electronics, components and advanced manufacturing.

zh.headline: 香港秋季電子產品展進入最後一天 會展聚焦AI與機械人
zh.dek: 貿發局主辦的秋電展及同期電子組件展匯聚逾3200家展商，周五下午5時結束，重點展示人工智能、機械人及未來產業。
body: 香港秋季電子產品展及同期舉行的國際電子組件及生產技術展周五進入最後一天，於灣仔香港會議展覽中心舉行。
由香港貿易發展局主辦的實體展期為10月13日至16日，匯聚來自15個國家及地區逾3200家展商。重點涵蓋人工智能、機械人、智慧生活及新世代娛樂，並設全新未來產業館展示前沿科技。
周五開放時間為上午9時30分至下午5時。入場僅限18歲或以上業內人士，現場登記費100元，使用電子入場證或已預先登記者免費。線上配對平台商對易則持續至10月23日。
貿發局表示，雙展為買家提供一站式採購消費電子、電子組件及先進製造方案的平台。
